scheme_name: To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Gujarat state
Water tank must be constructed on applicant’s own farmland
Farmer must have adopted the Micro Irrigation System (MIS)
Farmer must cover at least one hectare of land per 75 cubic meters of water tank under MIS
Group must consist of two or more farmers
One farmer must be selected as the leader to submit the application on behalf of the group
Water tank must be constructed on the land of one of the farmers in the group
Each group member must have adopted the Micro Irrigation System (MIS)
Group must cover at least one hectare per 75 cubic meters of water tank under MIS
Group must provide a mutual consent certificate (no separate registration required)
Benefit is available only once in a lifetime for both individual and group applicants
benefits_summary: Provides 50% of the water tank cost up to ₹9,80,000, available only once in a lifetime.
